Application Data.NAME: Stitch & Style Boutique
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Stitch & Style Boutique specializes in bespoke tailoring and alterations, offering personalized services for both individual and corporate clients. We cater to a diverse clientele, providing custom garment design, alterations for special events, and repair services for various types of clothing. Our operations prioritize quality control, maintaining meticulous records of customer garments and ensuring secure storage. We are committed to customer satisfaction, implementing robust inventory management practices and staff training to mitigate risks of theft and workmanship issues. Additionally, we employ regular maintenance on all equipment to minimize fire hazards and ensure safe working conditions. Cybersecurity measures are in place to protect customer data, reflecting our dedication to safeguarding personal information and maintaining trust.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 05/12/2023, an employee inadvertently damaged a customer's high-end suit during alteration, resulting in a loss of $1,200. The loss was covered by the business's liability insurance and the claim has been settled. Additionally, there was a minor theft incident on 08/25/2022 where several designer fabrics valued at $300 were stolen; this claim is still pending investigation with law enforcement.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade I, Fire-resistant, TL-15 Certified
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Enhanced security measures with monitored alarm system, regular inventory audits, and employee background checks.
